derivative.description: Independent knee-length open-front coat derived from the licensed shirt, body topology and rig proportions. Exact polygon clipping creates a continuous smooth placket with interpolated normals and blended skin weights instead of a jagged triangle-selection boundary. The flared lower shell overlaps and encloses the upper hem to remove the hip seam; blended hips, spine and upper-leg weights preserve posing and body morphs.
derivative.runtime: Loaded locally as glTF 2.0, rebound to identically named VRM bones and recolored by the selected wardrobe item. The inner top remains visible through the front opening and uses a conditional shoulder-compression morph to stay inside the coat; independent trousers remain visible below the hem.
